verdict.rationale: Undermind documents its own bulk capabilities. Its MCP tools resolve titles, DOIs or an entire bibliography into papers in bulk, and read full-text PDFs in parallel to answer questions across many papers at once. The enterprise page also claims batch processing for high-volume research. However, workspace actions such as starring and foldering are not documented as bulk operations, and batch processing is a one-line enterprise marketing claim with no documented interface. The MCP reference also says MCP is the only developer surface, with no REST API. Missing for 10: documented bulk mutation of workspace items (star/folder/delete many at once), a documented batch-processing interface with limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
